t: The most powerful STM32 chip, built to run vision AI on a tiny board.
steps: Buy an OpenMV N6 from the OpenMV store for about 215 US dollars.
Install the free OpenMV IDE on your computer.
Plug the camera into your computer with a USB-C cable.
Click the connect button in the IDE and open the Hello World example.
Press run and watch the live video in the frame window.
Try the face detection example next.
Load a ready vision model from the STM32 model zoo for bigger projects.
Move to a Nucleo-N657X0-Q and Zephyr later for C work. Install STM32CubeProgrammer and the signing tool first.
meta: Open Board. From $68.85. A few stores.
